## 🐸 Ribbit Rally {{VERSION}}

Eight hoppy frogs on jetskis, 81 pond courses across 4 levels, power-ups, koi carp and a lot of ribbits.

### What's new

- **2-player split screen:** press **2 Players** on the title screen to race a friend on one screen. Use one keyboard, two game controllers, or a tablet with a set of buttons for each player.
- **Back on track:** spin out and end up facing the wrong way, or get stuck, and after 3 seconds you're popped back on the track facing the right way.
- **Live leaderboard:** every racer from first to last in the top right corner, so you can see where everyone is.
- **Swells:** a gentle current rolls little humps of water down every course. Ride over them, or hit one fast and get a little air.
- **New track, Tower Twister (Level 4):** a corkscrew water-slide tower with a giant drop.
- **Dancing frogs:** hover over a frog on the frog picker and it dances. Zippy shimmies, Lulu twerks, Bonk rubs his tummy, Pip's hat spins, Mango dabs, Douglas does the robot, Fern pulls a silly face and Rocket moonwalks.
- Bonk now says his line in one slow, dopey go.
- Two Level 4 tracks (Surf Slope Scramble and Neon Skyway) are gone, leaving 81 tracks.

### Which file do I download?

Scroll down to **Assets** and pick the one for your device:

| Your device | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows PC** | `Ribbit-Rally-{{VERSION}}-windows-setup.exe` installs the game (works on normal and ARM Windows PCs). Or use `...-windows-portable.exe`, which runs straight away with nothing to install. |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3, M4: most Macs from 2021 onwards) | the `.dmg` with **arm64** in its name |
| **Mac with an Intel chip** (older Macs) | the `.dmg` with **x64** in its name |
| **Linux PC** | the `.AppImage` (works on any Linux) or the `.deb` (Ubuntu, Debian, Mint). Pick **x86_64 / amd64** for most PCs, **arm64** for ARM machines like a Raspberry Pi 4/5. |
| **iPhone, iPad, Android, Chromebook** | play in the web browser at **https://{{OWNER}}.github.io/{{NAME}}/**. You can also use "Add to Home Screen" to keep it like an app. |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu  → **About This Mac** → look for "Chip" (Apple) or "Processor" (Intel).

### Opening it the first time

This is a free indie game without a paid Microsoft or Apple certificate, so your computer will ask you to confirm it's OK the first time:

- **Windows:** if a blue "Windows protected your PC" box appears, click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** open the `.dmg` and drag **Ribbit Rally** into **Applications**. The first time you open it, macOS may say it can't check the app. Click **Done**, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**. (On older macOS you can right-click the app → **Open** instead.)
- **Linux (.AppImage):** right-click the file → **Properties** → **Permissions** → tick **Allow executing file as program**, then double-click it.

### How to play

Steer with the **arrow keys** or **A / D**, brake with **▼ / S**, and use items with **Space**. Press **F11** for full screen. On a phone or tablet, use the big on-screen buttons.

**Two players:** press **2 Players** on the title screen for split screen. Player 1: A / D to steer, S to brake, Space for items. Player 2: arrow keys and Enter. Or plug in two game controllers.
